$comment: Replay of a real /make run (2026-11-01): moving every project into one folder layout. Reconstructed from the procedure, the wiki commits made after each phase, the affected repos' commits and the session log of the run. Times are shown only where a commit fixes them (HH:MM, local); other events are in order without a time. Anonymised: no paths, hosts, prompts or log text.
title: Moving 5 repositories into one place

events.text: No procedure existed for this move. Wrote one: a fixed move map, and one rule for every phase — stop → move → fix paths → start → check.
Read-only inventory: folders, service units, paths inside configs, scheduled jobs, agent history, Docker volumes.
Open questions the plan cannot answer alone: an untracked eval file in jev, a project inside a mistyped folder, an old secrets backup.
Decided each one: keep the eval file, move the project from the mistyped folder, delete the backup instead of archiving it.
Wiki updated: secrets never go into the archive; a resolver bug in the executor fixed.
Plan checked against preconditions and policies.
Stopped the database, moved the project, kept the data volume, started it again.
Found an environment file readable by other users — tightened to owner-only.
Container healthy, nothing exposed.
Checks updated: the exposure check now honours documented exceptions.
Service stop requires sudo → marked as a human step.
Stopped the system service in a real terminal (sudo is human-only).
Moved the board, rebuilt its virtualenv from pinned versions, re-pointed the service unit and the Claude Code hooks.
A scripted edit of the unit failed on the first try: the service crash-looped. The board was down for about 9 minutes until the unit was fixed.
Procedure updated: a service counts as up only if it is active and its restart counter does not grow; every check call has a timeout.
Merged the hooks pull request (merging is human-only).
Board answers locally and over the private network; the tablet loads it.
A policy check was called the wrong way (without the compose file) — the evidence did not prove what the plan claimed.
Re-checked with the right call.
Stopped the API, the console and the agent session; moved jev; synced its environment from the lockfile; relinked the service.
Committed the jev changes (jev accepts changes only as patches the owner applies).
An API key showed up in the verifier's output: a config-rendering command expands environment files.
Rotated the key.
All checks pass except secrets: 8 findings already in jev's history before the move — reported, not hidden.
Rule added: the verifier never runs commands that expand secrets.
Deleting files is an ASK step.
Approved deleting stray secret backups.
Archived old logs, removed the empty old folders.
Nothing left outside the new layout.
Registry updated; procedure marked done with the phase lessons.
Moved the wiki itself (the running skill lives there) and re-linked it.
Final checks: compose policy 3/3 (one warning: some containers run as root), exposure clean, containers healthy, reboot test passed. Home folder holds only projects.
